SceneGraphNodeProxy.name: SceneGraphNode
SceneGraphNodeProxy.Documentation: A node in a scenegraph stores a local transform, its child nodes, and bound pipeline sources/filters. All node operations are implemented in the SceneGraph class.

StringVectorProperty.name: Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Display names for the GUI tree and for path addressing (e.g. "World/Table/Cup"). Sibling names are made unique.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: LocalTransform
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: The node's transform relative to its parent, as a 4x4 matrix in row-major order. A node's world transform is its parent's world transform composed with this one.

InputProperty.name: Sources
InputProperty.Documentation: The pipeline sources/filters bound to this node.

SceneGraphProxy.name: SceneGraph
SceneGraphProxy.Documentation: A scenegraph is a tree of nodes whose transforms compose down the tree and are applied to the representations of the sources bound to each node.

ProxyProperty.name: TargetViews
ProxyProperty.Documentation: The 3D render views this scenegraph applies to.
